rubric_items.reason: Built on existing layers and modules, but uses the database now() instead of the injected service clock and does not reuse the existing NextAppointment type and HMS-1 next-appointment query.
Every story S-1..S-6 is mapped to components, and the field rules (status filters, starts_at > now, counts over all dates, zone from useSettings) cover each AC.
Every new field has name, type, nullability, format and example; the shape duplicates NextAppointment instead of naming it, and the tie-break for latest COMPLETED is not stated.
Choices are cited or decided by A-01..A-03; the id field is marked Assumed when product types already prove it, and the cited basis (display codes) is indirect.
Trade-offs cover server-side visits, clock, warning style and privacy; the database-clock trade-off misses its cost for testing a fixed 'now'.
Clear, consistent and easy to follow; front matter and body agree.
